subject.title: tools.exec.approvalRunningNoticeMs is documented but rejected by the 2026.3.24 config schema

question: Should maintainers adopt/rebase the open fork repair, replace it with a narrow same-repo schema fix, or close that fork PR before queueing a new repair for this issue?
rationale: The bug and fix shape are clear, but an open non-maintainer-editable fork PR has closing syntax for this issue and is conflicting with unrelated stale changes, so automation should not open a duplicate repair without maintainer direction.

options.title: Replace With Narrow Repair
options.body: Close or supersede the fork PR and land a same-repo schema-only fix with focused config coverage.

options.title: Adopt The Fork
options.body: Have a maintainer manually rebase and strip the fork branch before review.

options.title: Keep Waiting
options.body: Leave the issue paired to the fork PR, accepting that the documented key remains broken until that branch is repaired.

recommendation.title: Replace With Narrow Repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the fork PR and land a same-repo schema-only fix with focused config coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the documented running-notice config behavior and is the strongest routing candidate for deciding whether to replace or adopt the stale repair branch.
